req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the PUT /players/{playerId} endpoint should return a 422 status code when called without a request body. This behavior ensures that the API enforces the presence of a request body for updates, which is crucial for maintaining data integrity. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct behavior with a valid body, a negative case to check the 422 response when the body is missing, and a boundary case to ensure the system handles minimal valid input correctly.

tests.name: test_put_player_with_valid_body
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 with a valid request body.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Assuming a player with squad number 10 exists
valid_body = {
    "first_name": "John",
    "middle_name": "",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "date_of_birth": "1990-01-01",
    "squad_number": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbr_position": "FW",
    "team": "Team A",
    "league": "League 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=valid_body)
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_put_player_without_body
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /players/squadnumber/10 without a request body.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Assuming a player with squad number 10 exists
response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10")
assert response.status_code == 422
